messages:
maya_cs: Quick sync  drafting a short customer-facing runbook for account priming, streaming fallbacks, and renewal-risk signals. Want to keep it a 1-pager + a tiny FAQ. Feedback?

alex_sre: Love the 1-pager approach. Make it action-first: detect -> act -> communicate. Include clear circuit-breaker numbers (p95, error rate) and a simple model-fallback ordering. :thumbsup:

jamal_pm: PM asks: 1) include a one-sentence explainer we can paste into renewal outreach about why priming matters, 2) a safe rollback checklist CS can call during noisy priming.

maya_cs: Proposed outline: 1) Preflight checks (expected qps, region, budget cap) 2) Priming run (what to prefill, key TTL, parallelism + jitter) 3) Live ops (what to monitor & thresholds) 4) Fallbacks (stream degrade -> compact model -> queue) 5) Customer communications. Thoughts?

sara_eng: Keep the priming example runnable. Tips: stagger tenant priming windows, use RNG offsets to avoid thundering herd, cap per-tenant priming to ~15% node capacity. Recommend prefix-based prefill (top N prefixes) for lower token cost.

maya_cs: Draft prefill CLI to hand customers:
```bash
redwood prefill --tenant T-987 --model rdx-small --keys top_prefixes.json --parallel 4 --ttl 3600 --jitter 30s
```
And a minimal proxy fallback snippet they can add:
```json
{"route_policy": [{"when": "p95_latency>1000", "action": "route_to:rdx-small"}, {"when": "queue_depth>50", "action": "batch_defer"}]}
```

alex_sre: Suggested operational thresholds: priming 30-90m before launch (stagger), priming concurrency <15% node capacity, circuit-breaker -> p95>1000ms for 3m OR error_rate>3% to trigger fallback, cost guardrail: require approval if estimated prefill spend > $200/day. Include on-call rotation contact.

lia_cs: Renewal-risk telemetry CS will watch: 7-day DAU drop >20%, sustained latency breaches, increasing % of streamed responses that time out, rising negative support sentiment. Propose a simple risk_score = weighted sum(usage_drop, latency_delta, error_rate, feedback_score). If risk_score >= 0.6 -> escalate to AM + solutions.

jamal_pm: Short customer-facing line for renewals: "We prime accounts ahead of launches to improve response quality and reduce latency. This may cause a small one-time cost; we'll notify you and can pause on request." Keep it brief.

maya_cs: Rollback checklist for CS: 1) Pause priming job 2) Flip routing to fallback model 3) If suspicious of primed content, clear primed keys for tenant 4) Open joint channel with eng-sre + PM 5) Offer to revert to prior config.

ops-bot: Job scheduled: prefill-T-987 (id: pf-abc123) start 2026-05-01T08:00:00Z.

sara_eng: Small perf note to add: when priming at scale, throttle tokenization calls (50ms gap) and prefer hashing prefixes rather than full-doc prefill to get coverage with fewer tokens. Also measure priming ROI: percent of requests that hit cache vs token spend.

maya_cs: I'll consolidate this into a 1-pager + 2 templates (customer notice + rollback email). Plan to publish draft tomorrow unless anyone objects.

alex_sre: No objections. Please include a line about expected visible signals in their telemetry dashboards (p95, error_rate, queue_depth).

lia_cs: I'll add example datapoints CS needs from telemetry for the risk_score calculation.

maya_cs: Thanks all  will share link when live.
